scope: First/middle/last episode per each of 15 catalog seasons; short decode near 60 seconds
metadata: Stream dimensions/codecs are FFprobe stream metadata, not master playlist declarations; FFmpeg separately performs actual 2-second decoding
limitations: Short samples do not prove complete or correctly labelled episodes
Output is decoded to null and not visually reviewed
Seeking includes demux/decode preroll internally; requested sample position is 60s
Transport bytes are not recorded and remote availability can change
3 Stranger Things S5 fast-input-seek attempts produced zero frames; actual after-input-seek fallback passed, both attempts preserved
Audio/video sync, native AVPlayer seeking and sustained in-app playback are outside this FFmpeg null-output validation

failed_seek_diagnosis.scope: Stranger Things S5 first and last representative failed-seek diagnosis
limits: Direct segment sample covers a declared HLS timeline near 60s but does not establish exact content position
